description: Mirror CookUnity's full weekly menu into a local database so you can plan meals offline — filter by macros, diet, and budget, and diff the menu week over week, none of which the web app can do.

novel_features.name: Macro-constrained meal planner
novel_features.description: Auto-build a set of meals that collectively hit your protein, calorie, budget, and diet targets — offline, in one command.

novel_features.name: Week-over-week menu drift
novel_features.description: See exactly which meals were added, removed, or repriced between two weekly menus.

novel_features.name: Best-value leaderboard
novel_features.description: Rank meals by nutritional value per dollar (protein-per-dollar, calories-per-dollar) computed from the local mirror.

novel_features.name: Favorites on this week's menu
novel_features.description: Show which of your favorited meals are actually on the current week's menu.

novel_features.name: Meal comparison
novel_features.description: Side-by-side macro, price, chef, and allergen comparison of two or more meals.

novel_features.name: Chef roster analytics
novel_features.description: Leaderboard of chefs by dish count, average rating, average price, and cuisines on the current menu.
